direct.system:
Execute ordered integer-list operations. Keep the remaining order unless sorting, reversing, rotating or swapping. Use exact integer arithmetic. Remove first k deletes exactly k leading elements; keep first k retains exactly k. Remove all x deletes every occurrence equal to x. Even includes zero. Rotate left moves the first k elements to the end in order. Swap first and last leaves the middle unchanged. Append adds one element at the end. Removing duplicates keeps first occurrences. Do not invent operations. Empty lists are valid execution answers. Return only requested JSON.
Operation enums and canonical wording:
reverse: Reverse the list.
sort_asc: Sort the list in ascending order.
sort_desc: Sort the list in descending order.
remove_first: Remove the first {arg} elements.
keep_first: Keep only the first {arg} elements.
remove_all: Remove all occurrences of {arg}.
add: Add {arg} to each number.
multiply: Multiply each number by {arg}.
keep_even: Keep only even numbers.
keep_odd: Keep only odd numbers.
rotate_left: Rotate left by {arg} positions (move the first {arg} elements to the end).
swap_ends: Swap the first and last elements.
append: Append {arg} to the end of the list.
unique: Remove duplicates, keeping the first occurrence of each number.
direct.instruction: Apply every instruction in order to the starting list. Return only {"answer":[...]} containing the final integer list.
